keyword: where is the nasa launch site
claims: NASA's primary launch site is the Kennedy Space Center (KSC).
The Kennedy Space Center (KSC) is on Merritt Island, Florida.
The Kennedy Space Center (KSC) is adjacent to Cape Canaveral Space Force Station.
Artemis lunar launches use the Kennedy Space Center's Launch Complex 39B.
Vandenberg Space Force Base is in California.
The Kennedy Space Center is the primary location for human spaceflight and deep space missions.
Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is in Florida.
Cape Canaveral Space Force Station is used for unmanned, scientific, and commercial satellite launches.
Vandenberg Space Force Base is used for polar and west-coast launches.
Wallops Flight Facility is in Virginia.
Wallops Flight Facility is used for smaller rockets and missions to the International Space Station.
Rocket launches can often be viewed from the Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex.
Rocket launches can often be viewed from surrounding areas on the Space Coast
